annotation_scope: All 25000 frozen test NN contexts, five backbones and ten datasets; three local annotation models. Same prompts, independent responses, no outcome-selected subset.
meaning: Labelled similarity is the approved broad same-meaning/behaviour feature; it is not a direct label of dataset ambiguity or convention clarification. Important contrast is a classification-relevant difference. Neither implies beneficial use by the outcome judge.
agreement: Per-model yes/no/uncertain/missing frequencies; pairwise exact agreement and Cohen kappa over common valid ternary labels; three-way agreement; majority requires at least two identical votes, otherwise unresolved. Preserve invalid/truncated separately. Do not treat majority as ground truth.
outcomes: Join to frozen original probability-only scores from ten outcome judges. On the same cases and cutoffs compare baseline with nearest. Report helped (wrong to correct), harmed (correct to wrong), stable correct, stable wrong, and helped-minus-harmed accuracy difference. Include stable cases, not only flips.
policies: Fixed probe0.5/judge50. Separately transfer each existing validation-F1-selected control, NN and saliency threshold pair unchanged to baseline and NN, then average the three paired outcomes per case. No retuning. Retain zero-cutoff cases. Also report each anchor separately.
weights: Inverse inclusion probability, normalize within model/backbone/dataset cell, then equal cell mass. Label-conditioned rates describe the annotated sample's represented support, not an unconditional full-population accuracy estimate. Main scope all six local outcome judges and each API judge's three-condition matched-valid subset. Common-valid-all-ten and non-annotator outcome judges are sensitivity checks.
hypothesis_tests: For each annotation source, compare helpful/harmful/net rates for yes versus no, with uncertain and missing explicit. Report both-label combinations, per dataset/outcome judge/backbone, all ten datasets and the prespecified toxicity subset (Aegis, BeaverTails, ToxicChat, ToxiGen). Stratify by neighbour-label alignment. Inspect continuous Brier-score change as threshold-free sensitivity.
adjustment: Weighted linear associations with both labels and their interaction; cell fixed effects, target class, neighbour-label agreement, within-backbone-dataset cosine rank, original probe probability and log target/reference lengths. Repeat with label-by-neighbour-alignment interactions. Separate correction rate among originally wrong decisions and harm rate among originally correct decisions. These remain observational associations.
uncertainty: Cluster by dataset and exact target content hash across repeated backbone, judge and anchor observations. Use cluster-robust intervals for regression and paired cluster bootstrap for headline yes-minus-no contrasts; thresholds and sampled cases held fixed. Equal-anchor averages are repeated uses of the same outcomes, not independent replication. Exploratory multiple comparisons, no causal or confirmatory significance claims.
data_integrity: Require completed manifests and exact 25000-case membership for all three; verify raw-output and final-file hashes; keep raw responses and previous invalid commits. No model calls or retries for this analysis. Parser-only fence normalization recorded, not concealed.
deliverables: HTML report, scientific summary figure, machine-readable agreement/group/adjusted results, verified source hashes and reproducible analysis. Assess support honestly, including null, conflicting, or harmful associations.
